apps.name: Symbios Settings
apps.subtitle: Halcyon Symbios settings over BLE
apps.localizedDescription: Read and change the settings of the Halcyon Symbios dive computer over Bluetooth LE (reverse-engineered). Grouped settings, gas-table editor (Nx/Trimix), timeouts & alarms, custom-fields editor, style & custom-function, settings profiles + auto-backup, offline-draft mode. Physical iPhone only (the Simulator has no BLE).
apps.versionDescription: Rename gas preset section to "Standardgase"; compact Connection/Device section.

versions.localizedDescription: Rename gas preset section to "Standardgase"; compact Connection/Device section.
Gas editor: O2/He as sliders + WUD standard-gas presets (incl. Air).
Inline sliders on the menu rows for numeric settings (GF, PO2/setpoints, brightness, timeouts, declination).
Cleaner UI: settings as a category menu; auto-reads on connect.
Style (Classic/Modern) and Custom Function (Best Gas/Stop Watch/Heading/Off) as dropdowns, device-confirmed.
Custom-fields editor (CF Content screen): 22 toggle fields mapped to bytes 48/53/63. Online + offline-draft.
Offline draft mode: edit all settings incl. gases without a connection, save as a profile, apply later.
First release: read/change settings, gas editor (Nx/Trimix, presets), timeouts & alarms, settings profiles + auto-backup.

permissions.usageDescription: Connects to the Halcyon Symbios over Bluetooth LE.
